text:
ops-bot: ALERT: %HOSTED-GW% region=us-west-2 tenant=brightleaf spike 5xx rate +504s > threshold. p95 latency >= 2.1s. auto-notify incident channel.

dena-support: FYI raised ticket INC-4628 from BrightLeaf (high volume). Customer seeing repeated 504/5xx on generate endpoints. They report timeouts for short prompts.

ingress-monitor-bot: metric snapshot: ingress_request_queue.depth=1200 (limit=1200), continuous_batcher.queue_latency_p95=2200ms, enqueue_rate spike 6k req/s. kv_cache_hits dropping.

linda-sre: looking. initial guess: request queue saturated -> continuous batching backlog -> dequeue timeouts and early failures.

jonah-eng: can repro locally with a thundering client. repro steps I'll paste below.

jonah-eng: repro snippet:
```bash
for i in {1..4000}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"hi"}' &
done; wait
```
This reproduces backlog quickly hitting queue depth.

maria-s: customer wants ETA and temporary workaround. any quick mitigation?

linda-sre: short-term: enable ingress adaptive_reject early for tenant (drop oldest) to keep p95 stable and avoid cascading 5xx. long-term: need better admission control and dynamic batch sizing.

jonah-eng: deployed rollback workaround: decreased batching_window from 16ms -> 6ms on continuous-batcher in us-west-2 and enabled tenant-level early_reject. rolling restart batcher pods (3 nodes) to flush backlog.

ops-bot: ACTION: rolling restart batchers started by jonah-eng (job id r-17524).

kevin-cs: sent BrightLeaf an interim note: "We see an ingress backlog causing timeouts; worked a mitigation and monitoring is greening up. Will follow up with root cause and timeline."

ingress-monitor-bot: after mitigation snapshot: queue.depth=420, p95=410ms, 5xx rate down 86%. kv_cache warmup in progress.

maria-s: nice. please capture exact traces/trace-ids for postmortem. customer asked if this was auth/billing — confirmed not related.

jonah-eng: grabbing traces: trace ids [tr-1752468023, tr-1752468031, tr-1752468039]. Logs show dequeue loop timeouts at ~2s and batch assembly age at 2.1s in backlog.

linda-sre: root-cause hypothesis: a sudden small-payload QPS spike combined with cold KV cache and a small batching window allowed backlog to accumulate to depth limit. When queue reached configured depth we observed simultaneous drop / early_reject fallback to 5xx from gateway. Two contributing config issues: queue_capacity set too low for multi-tenant surge; batching_window static rather than adaptive; and no gradual degradation policy that preserves p95 for small prompts.

dena-support: customer impact summary for ticket: "Intermittent 504/5xx for short prompts during high traffic window. Mitigated by throttling and reduced batching. No data exposure or billing errors."

jonah-eng: next steps I'm pushing: (1) temporary raise queue_capacity for hosted gateway by 30% in us-west-2 (2) fast follow: enable adaptive_batch_window pilot that reduces batch_wait when queue_depth surges (3) postmortem doc + perf regression test.

maria-s: estimate for (1)?

jonah-eng: done in 2m. changed config key ingress.queue_capacity.us-west-2 -> 1560.

ops-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE recorded by jonah-eng: ingress.queue_capacity.us-west-2=1560.

kevin-cs: customer confirmed improved success rate and lowered p95. asked for SLA credit? flagged to billing team to evaluate.

linda-sre: assigning postmortem owner @jonah-eng. please include reproducer script, metrics, config diff, and timeline.

jonah-eng: will post draft within 24h.

maria-s: tagging :thumbsup: — close thread once postmortem link posted.

dena-support: closing customer ticket after postmortem + follow-up.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: status=mitigated, region=us-west-2, impact=partial, start=1752468019, mitigated=1752468039.

maria-s: thanks team.
